summary: Global Ship Lease, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 22, 2026, reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing contains a press release and interim financial statements. It includes routine operational updates such as dividend declarations, vessel acquisitions, and forward sales of non-core ships. No extraordinary corporate event—such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign—is disclosed. The forward sales of three ships are ordinary-course asset dispositions, not a material divestiture. This is a standard earnings release with no special-situation implications.
